_comment: Incidence data for the prose-moves graph. Rendered by `uv run prose-graph-viz`. Papers with band='control' are the negative control. ptype='ai' = machine draft of the same content (human-vs-AI axis). ptype='placeholder' = a still-empty control slot drawn so the missing counterfactual stays visible. Move degree counts PUBLISHED papers only; control edges are drawn but never counted, so an AI draft that reproduces a move shows an edge without inflating its 'genre law' degree.
